The '''Council of Colonists''' was the fabricated name of a group of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperials]] put together by [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] as part of an elaborate trap designed to discover and defeat an [[Ebruchi]] force in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]].
